analyst_view.overall: Early view: a relegation-zone game between Eldense (15th) under Javi Calleja and Andorra (19th) under Carles Manso. Andorra's goalkeeper Jesús Owono was sent off after the collision in which Tenerife's Jesús de Miguel was fatally injured, and the club has had a hard month; the bans listed for Owono, Lautaro De León, Efe Akman and Eldense's Juan Larios should all be served before mid-December. Eldense have struggled to score (Jorge Rastrojo top scorer with three) while Andorra's games are open.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Andorra's matches average over three goals but Eldense have scored only 13 in 13, so the two pull in opposite directions and I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Under Calleja Eldense keep the ball and push players into the box late on, and Andorra push their lines high, so I lean slightly higher.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.5 cards. It is a game between two sides near the bottom, but no referee is known yet, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.1 shots. Eldense took 13 shots with 59% of the ball against Granada and Andorra leave space, so I lean a little higher.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. Eldense's finishing has been poor, which offsets the volume, so I stay with the number.
